name: Yuzhang Shang
title: Assistant Professor
department: Computer Science; Artificial Intelligence Initiative affiliation
fitReason: REMAC adapts action-chunking policies for real-time asynchronous execution. It connects Shang’s efficient multimodal-model research to physical grasp-and-place, with a concrete policy-inference and deployment-systems angle.

physicalEvidence.summary: REMAC’s January 2026 full primary paper names Shang with a UCF affiliation and evaluates a seven-DoF Franka Research 3 with a pi0-based VLA on three real grasp/place tasks, 30 trials per method/task. The score measures stage-based progress rather than binary full-task success. Gripper tactile sensors are disabled in this setup; no tactile-policy result is implied.

shortVisit.summary: His directly retrieved EXceL page expressly invites visiting scholars/students and master’s/undergraduate researchers. It requests recruitment inquiries only at yuzhang.hire@gmail.com. The invitation has no published summer 2027 dates or external-master’s short-visit terms.

scoreReasons.physical: REMAC real Franka trials are verified in a UIC/Cisco/UCF collaboration; current UCF-local setup and visitor access are unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Direct current visitor/master’s invitation; duration, external eligibility and summer capacity unspecified.

name: Huaxiu Yao
school: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
title: Assistant Professor
department: Computer Science; joint appointment in Data Science and Society
fitReason: GRAPE aligns generalist robot policies with preference-informed trajectories; it offers a specific manipulation-policy project within a broader adaptive-agent laboratory.

physicalEvidence.summary: GRAPE’s full primary paper reports a Franka arm with a Robotiq gripper on 30 physical tasks, ten attempts per task (300 executions), including pick/place, button presses and knocking. Additional generalization evaluations are separate from Simpler-Env/LIBERO simulation.

shortVisit.summary: A directly retrieved current AIMING page explicitly invites interns/visiting students throughout the year, directing applicants to a form and a CV email. This is a general inquiry route rather than a confirmed summer 2027 appointment.

scoreReasons.fit: Concrete VLA preference alignment and generalization within a broader AI-agent program.
scoreReasons.physical: GRAPE real Franka validation is from a February 2025 multi-institution paper; current UNC-local equipment is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit current all-year interns/visiting-students pathway, but no duration or external-master’s eligibility terms.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current 2026 lab activity and conference listing; directly checked physical experiment dates to February 2025.
